steps.content: When you open your eyes again, countless specks of light are swirling and floating in the distant sky, almost like a storm is brewing.
The members of FAC and that strange mech are not here. It seems that you've been pulled into a different spacetime.
You step forward, feeling the solid rock under your feet. Everything feels real, but under the red light, the familiar feeling returns.

You see the buildings in the distance constantly changing and weathering. Although you haven't been affected yet, the spacetime here doesn't seem stable. The boundary between reality and illusion isn't so clear either.
The wasteland is not so quiet anymore. The howl of monsters is echoing. But this time it's different, you're wide awake and prepared. Defeat them, find a way out, and more importantly...
Find the "old friend" trapped by that evil moon, travel through time and bring her back.
